title: Migrate customer, vendor and item transactions for BC14 cloud migration
summary: Extends BC14 cloud migration to stage customer, vendor, and item subledger transactions alongside G/L entries, enabling migration of open receivables, payables, and inventory for both current and historical data.
key_points: Adds buffer tables for customer, vendor, and item ledger entries with detailed posting setup
Implements current migrators that post open entries through general and item journals to cloud company
Provides historical migrators to copy archived source entries into HybridBC14HistoricalData app for reference
Each migrator is gated by module flags to run only when relevant modules are selected
Includes comprehensive test coverage for all current and historical migrators
